study_parts.in_vivo_exercise_miRNA: Gene SMART cohort, vastus lateralis biopsies at baseline and 3 h after one HIIE bout (S5.5.p1, S5.7.p1), 44 participants (24 M / 20 F), TaqMan human miRNA A+B arrays (S5.8.p1), 308 detected miRNAs; limma means model ~0 + Sex.Timepoint + BMI + Wpeak, duplicateCorrelation on participant ID (S5.9.3.p1). No GEO accession is named for these arrays (DA.p1 cites GSE242861 and Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.8412095 only).
study_parts.in_vitro_miR30_overexpression: Primary myotubes from 3 male + 3 female donors, transfected 24 h with miR-30a mimic, miR-30c mimic or scramble (S5.9.1.p1); total RNA-seq, kallisto transcript counts, DESeq2 ~ Sex * Condition, prefilter <10 RPM in <2 samples (S5.9.2.p1). This is the part deposited as GSE242861.

primary_estimand: Paper-wide: sex differences in skeletal-muscle miRNA expression at baseline and in the miRNA response to acute HIIE (pre vs 3 h post, by sex, sex x time interaction). Exercise is an in-vivo factor of the miRNA array data only.
planned_contrasts: miRNA arrays: male vs female at baseline (S2.1.p1; 148 miRNAs)
miRNA arrays: post vs pre exercise in females (S2.2.p1; 4 up, 0 down)
miRNA arrays: post vs pre exercise in males (S2.2.p1; 148 up, 2 down)
miRNA arrays: sex x exercise interaction (S2.2.p1; 111 miRNAs)
RNA-seq (GSE242861): male vs female donor cells, scramble (S2.7.p1; 26 genes)
RNA-seq (GSE242861): miR-30a vs scramble in males (18 up/23 down) and females (16 up/23 down) (S2.7.p2)
RNA-seq (GSE242861): miR-30c vs scramble in males (13 up/12 down) and females (10 up/11 down) (S2.8.p1)

factors.donor: 6 donor cell lines, each with all three treatments

inclusion: 18 RNA-seq libraries = 6 donors x 3 treatments; no exercise or time factor in the RNA-seq
paper_method: RNA-seq: DESeq2 ~ Sex * Condition on kallisto counts; arrays: limma mixed model with duplicateCorrelation
